title: Local action data cannot normalize charge without a primitive global circle and faithful observed carrier

normalization_boundary.local_rescaling: For c>0, Q maps to cQ, A maps to A/c, kappa maps to c^2 kappa, and mu maps to mu/c^2; the covariant derivative, kappa-weighted gauge kinetic term and mu||Qphi||^2 are unchanged after field and gauge-parameter/ghost redefinition
normalization_boundary.local_invariants: Local Euler, Gauss, BRST and BFV data can depend on Q/sqrt(kappa), mu kappa, charge ratios and spectral subspaces, but cannot separately normalize Q
normalization_boundary.global_circle: Every continuous U(1)-to-U(1) homomorphism has integer degree d and is an automorphism exactly for d=plus_or_minus 1. A primitive global circle fixes topological normalization only up to sign; the same-sector kinetic coefficient is still required for physical coupling normalization
normalization_boundary.required_selector_tuple: An action-stationary primitive circle, its action-derived physical quotient or BRST carrier, a domain-preserving faithful observed intertwiner J satisfying QJ=plus_or_minus J Y_prim, and the same action's kinetic coefficient kappa
normalization_boundary.fixed_ktype_exclusion: K1357's 27-dimensional K-type has charge set {-4,-2,0,2,4} with gcd 2 and exp(i pi Q)=1. W222's comparator-only primitive lattice 6Y={1,-4,2,-3,6,0} has gcd 1. The fixed K-type cannot be the complete primitive observed carrier through a circle automorphism
normalization_boundary.ceiling: Only that fixed K-type is excluded. Other K-types in H_ps, another compact circle, nonlinear or nonlocal observation, and a future source-derived reduction remain open; W222 supplies relative comparator arithmetic, not source ownership
